subject: Security/compliance discovery — SOC2 & vendor questionnaire (FinCo)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finco.com>, security@finco.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 14:05 -0700
Subject: Security/compliance discovery — SOC2 & vendor questionnaire (FinCo)

Thanks for the time earlier today, Alex — great to meet the FinCo security team. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II for our inference platform (most recent audit completed 2025). I can share the report and a summary of scope.
- Data protection: we support GDPR controls and can sign a standard DPA/DP Addendum. For PHI workloads, we offer Private deployments and can execute a BAA (we discussed this briefly).
- Vendor questionnaire: you mentioned a VSQ that your procurement/security team uses. Please send the template and we’ll start filling it.
- Roadmap: we have ISO 27001 planned (target H2 2027) and are evaluating SOC scope expansion for additional services in early 2027. FedRAMP is exploratory at this stage.

Proposed next steps:
1) Alex to share your vendor questionnaire (you said security@finco would be included).
2) I’ll circulate SOC2 summary + attach the full report and a kickoff VSQ response spreadsheet by EOD Wed (Aug 26).
3) Schedule a 30m follow-up week of Sept 7 to walk the answers and roadmap (ISO/SOC expansion).

Let me know if I missed anything from the call.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: none in this message (SOC2 + VSQ responses to follow)

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@finco.com
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:12 -04:00
Subject: Re: Security/compliance discovery — SOC2 & vendor questionnaire (FinCo)

Thanks, Marissa — appreciate the recap. A few clarifications before you send artifacts: 

- Scope: can you confirm the in-scope services for your SOC 2 report (inference API, hosted storage, customer telemetry)? We need the scope to map to our procurement requirements.
- HIPAA/PHI: FinCo will process some PHI in a limited set of workflows. Can you confirm Redwood’s posture on PHI and whether you’ll sign a BAA for Dedicated/Private deployments?
- Encryption/KMS: confirm whether customers can bring/manage keys (KMS/HSM) in Private deployments and whether keys are used for persisted data vs in-memory only.
- ISO/FedRAMP: helpful to know timelines — do you have a public roadmap or milestones?

I’m attaching our vendor questionnaire template (FinCo_VSQ_Template_2026.xlsx). If possible, please start with the standard questions (control ownership, encryption, incident response, personnel screening).

We’d like the SOC2 report and a preliminary VSQ response by EOD Friday Aug 28 if feasible. If not, propose an alternative date.

Best,
Alex Chen
Head of Security Engineering, FinCo
alex.chen@finco.com

Attachment: FinCo_VSQ_Template_2026.xlsx

- Lauren: review SOC2 scope excerpt and confirm the exact services included and any recent changes to model hosting or telemetry that affect scope.

Timeline: we should aim to send the initial packet (SOC2 + VSQ seed answers) by Fri 2026-08-28 17:00 PT. If you need more time, propose a new date to me and I’ll push the timeline with FinCo.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 10:15 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security/compliance discovery — SOC2 & vendor questionnaire (FinCo)

Alex — attaching the requested items and a short answers packet to get the VSQ started. See attachments and brief notes below. Happy to jump on the follow-up call week of Sept 7 to walk through in detail.

Quick answers / summary:
- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II (report date: 2025-09-30). In-scope services: Redwood inference API (hosted), private deployment control plane, customer-managed Dedicated clusters. Non-production training infra is excluded. Full report attached (Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf).
- PHI / HIPAA: We support PHI workloads via Private and Dedicated deployments and will execute a BAA for customers that require it. Attached: Redwood_BAA_template.pdf.
- Encryption / KMS: Customer-managed keys supported in Private via standard KMS integrations (persisted data encryption at rest). Transit encryption TLS 1.2+ by default. We’ll include keys usage details in the VSQ spreadsheet.
- ISO/FedRAMP roadmap: ISO 27001 targeted for H2 2027 (internal milestones: gap assessment Q1 2027, remediations Q2 2027). SOC scope expansion for additional control domains planned for Q1 2027. FedRAMP: exploratory; no firm timeline yet.

Attachments included: 
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (redacted executive summary + report stub)
- Redwood_VSQ_responses_FinCo.xlsx (seeded answers, control owners tagged)
- Redwood_BAA_template.pdf

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwood-FinCo-VSQ
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/FINCO-2345

If you’d like an internal SME on the call, I’ll bring Rishi for controls questions and Lauren for scope/architecture. Proposed 30m slots: Sept 7 09:00 PT or Sept 8 11:00 PT — which works for your team?

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123
